mapper.select: SELECT A.ITEM_CODE, A.AVAIL_QTY, A.MIN_QTY, A.MIN_QTY - A.AVAIL_QTY AS SHORT_QTY FROM (SELECT I.ITEM_CODE , I.MIN_QTY , CASE WHEN I.ITEM_TY = 'QTY' THEN I.STOCK_QTY ELSE (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_UNIT U WHERE U.ITEM_CODE = I.ITEM_CODE AND U.STTUS = 'STORED') - I.RESERVED_QTY END AS AVAIL_QTY FROM ASSET_ITEM I WHERE I.USE_AT = 'Y') A WHERE A.AVAIL_QTY < A.MIN_QTY ORDER BY A.ITEM_CODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ASSET_SHORTAGE_RUN (RUN_ID, RUN_TY, RUN_PNTTM, ITEM_CNT, RUN_USER_ID) VALUES (#{runId}, #{runTy}, SYSDATE(), #{itemCnt}, #{runUserId})

(#{runId}, #{it.itemCode}, #{it.availQty}, #{it.minQty}, #{it.shortQty})
mapper.select: SELECT R.RUN_ID , R.RUN_TY , DATE_FORMAT(R.RUN_PNTTM, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS RUN_PNTTM , R.ITEM_CNT , R.RUN_USER_ID , E.USER_NM AS RUN_USER_NM FROM ASSET_SHORTAGE_RUN R LEFT JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO E ON E.EMPLYR_ID = R.RUN_USER_ID ORDER BY R.RUN_PNTTM DESC, R.RUN_ID DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_SHORTAGE WHERE RUN_ID = #{runId}
